metadata.title: Constituency boundaries: East Are'are, West Are'are and Small Malaita
metadata.source: Solomon Islands National Statistics Office (SINSO), 2009 Census of Population and Housing; published by OCHA ROAP as Solomon Islands - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), admin level 2
metadata.licence: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO 3.0)
metadata.changes: Three constituencies extracted; reprojected from World Mercator (central meridian 150) to WGS 84; simplified (Douglas-Peucker, about 44 m); islets under about 0.5 ha removed; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals; attributes reduced to ADM2_NAME, ADM2_PCODE, ADM1_NAME.
metadata.note: Electoral units, not customary land boundaries. Inland lines between constituencies are schematic.
